description: Automerge every update, majors included, once the required CI checks pass (GitHub native auto-merge). Libraries are bumped in libs.versions.toml (the catalog MODULE.bazel reads) and Bazel modules in MODULE.bazel; renovate-pins.yml then re-pins the lockfiles on the PR's branch (bazel/renovate/repin.sh)

packageRules.description: kotlinx-datetime publishes '-0.6.x-compat' sibling releases; they are not upgrades

Kotlin and what's built for one Kotlin release move together: Kotlin's plugins (the Compose compiler among them), rules_kotlin (it bundles the compiler Bazel runs, which must equal the catalog's kotlin), and the Metro and Mappie compiler plugins. Split groups open PRs that each fail alone
AGP and the lint it runs release together (lint's version is AGP's + 23); Bazel's Android lint pins lint-gradle beside AGP

customManagers.description: The Go SDK rules_go downloads for the Gazelle extension (MODULE.bazel's go_sdk.download)
